stories.name: GE Aerospace Earnings
stories.blurb: GE Aerospace is posting strong, record earnings and raising its profit outlook on robust engine demand, but investors are questioning whether the stock's rally has already priced in its growth.

stories.name: Boeing Q3 earnings
stories.blurb: Boeing's mixed third-quarter results and cash flow concerns are driving volatility and analyst target cuts in its stock.

stories.name: Boeing 737 Max certification
stories.blurb: The long-delayed FAA certification of Boeing's 737 Max 7 and Max 10 variants, marked by software issues and repeated schedule slips.

stories.name: Archer-Boeing Deal
stories.blurb: Archer Aviation is acquiring Boeing subsidiaries Wisk Aero, Insitu, and SkyGrid, a deal that boosts Archer's growth prospects and stock price in the eVTOL/air taxi market.

stories.name: Boeing F/A-XX Contract Win
stories.blurb: Boeing won a roughly $20 billion U.S. Navy contract to build the next-generation F/A-XX carrier fighter jet, sending its stock higher and opening a long-term defense revenue stream.

stories.name: Defense Stocks Surge
stories.blurb: Rising government defense spending, missile stockpile initiatives, and strong earnings are driving a broad rally in defense and aerospace stocks like Lockheed Martin, RTX, and Rocket Lab.

past.name: Aerospace Q3 earnings
past.blurb: Third-quarter earnings results and investor reaction across major aerospace companies, including Boeing, GE Aerospace, Hexcel, Honeywell, RTX, and United Airlines.

past.name: Boeing 737 Max certification
past.blurb: Boeing is working through regulatory certification and production delays for its 737 Max variants while trying to stabilize output.

past.name: Boeing Regulatory & Orders Update
past.blurb: Boeing navigates FAA regulatory approvals, safety inspections, and emissions exemptions while securing new aircraft orders and deliveries across its commercial jet lineup.

11.text: Boeing is named only in a market report forecasting the narrowbody aircraft segment will reach $126.9 billion, with Airbus, Boeing, and GE Aerospace positioned to benefit from fuel-efficient fleet demand. Other articles focus on GE Aerospace, RTX, Airbus, defense stocks, and WeightWatchers, offering no new Boeing developments.

5.text: Boeing reported Q3 and nine-month losses, record defense and total backlog, and FAA certification of the 737-10, but pushed its $10 billion free cash flow target to 2029 and lowered 737 MAX production targets, extending delivery delays. Avolon ordered 140 737-10s, two directors bought shares, and analysts remain divided as the stock fell.

8.text: Boeing finalized a record 140-jet 737-10 order from lessor Avolon, lifting Avolon's MAX backlog above 240, and agreed to convert one 767-300 freighter for Icelease with options for two more. Boeing also forecast Middle East fleets doubling by 2045, requiring nearly 3,000 new airplanes.

6.text: Archer Aviation shares fell 15% in a month and dropped another 5% as rival Joby rose on a revenue beat. The articles cover Archer's stock moves and eVTOL market outlook, with Boeing barely mentioned.

10.text: BAE Systems completed its 1,000th KC-135 repair, sustaining the Air Force tanker fleet Boeing built. Curtiss-Wright, Leidos and BWX reported strong Q3 defense earnings, but Democratic election wins may slow defense spending.

7.text: Boeing appears only in Dow movers lists: among top gainers on Nov. 2, 2026, and among decliners on Nov. 5, 2026. The other articles cover Nasdaq, Nvidia, and Dow sessions without Boeing specifics.
